# CoreForge

> CoreForge is a Bengaluru-based engineering and technology company providing practical hardware, embedded systems, IoT, PCB design, custom software, web development, mobile applications, and technical training.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://coreforgeindia.com/): Primary engineering portal and company overview.
- [About CoreForge](https://coreforgeindia.com/about): Company background, mission, and MSME engineering team.
- [Engineering Services](https://coreforgeindia.com/services): Hardware design, embedded firmware, custom software, and workshops.
- [Portfolio & Case Studies](https://coreforgeindia.com/portfolio): Delivered engineering projects, PCB prototypes, and software platforms.
- [Products & Hardware Kits](https://coreforgeindia.com/products): Hardware development kits, DIY electronics, and prototyping equipment.
- [Engineering FAQs](https://coreforgeindia.com/faqs): Technical FAQs, service processes, and project timelines.
- [Careers & Internships](https://coreforgeindia.com/careers): Job openings and paid engineering internships in Bengaluru.
- [Contact CoreForge](https://coreforgeindia.com/contact): Inquiries, technical consultation, and custom project quotes.
- [Engineering Blog](https://coreforgeindia.com/blog): Technical articles, IoT architecture tutorials, and PCB design guides.

## Hardware & Embedded Solutions

- [PCB Design Services](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/pcb-design): Multi-layer PCB schematic design, high-speed routing, and prototyping.
- [Embedded Systems & Firmware](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/embedded-systems): STM32, ESP32, FreeRTOS programming, and sensor integration.
- [Electronics Product Design](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/product-design): End-to-end electronic product engineering from concept to assembly.
- [Hardware Consulting](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/consulting): Design reviews, thermal analysis, and component selection.

## Software & Digital Solutions

- [Custom Software Development](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/software/custom-software): Enterprise ERP, CRM, and automated business platforms.
- [Web Development & E-Commerce](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/software/web-development): Fast web platforms, portals, and e-commerce applications.
- [Mobile App Development](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/software/mobile-apps): Android & iOS cross-platform mobile app engineering.
- [Business Intelligence & Dashboards](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/software/business-intelligence): Real-time telemetry, analytics, and data portals.

## Training & Education

- [Embedded Systems Bootcamps](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/embedded-training): Hands-on STM32 and IoT engineering bootcamps.
- [Hardware & PCB Design Courses](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/hardware-courses): Practical KiCad and multi-layer PCB design training.
- [Software Development Programs](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/software-programs): Full-stack web and mobile development courses.
- [Corporate & College Workshops](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/workshops): FDPs, student bootcamps, and technical mentoring.
- [DIY Electronics Kits](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/diy-kits): Prototyping hardware, robotics kits, and STEM education modules.
